meta.listDescription: Deadlock item win rates, buy rates and purchase timings by hero, rank and patch, with sample sizes.
meta.detailDescription: {item}: win rate, buy rate and purchase timings by hero, rank and patch, with sample sizes.

list.title: Item performance
list.description: How often each item is bought, when, and how those matches ended. Open an item for its purchase timings.
list.howWinRate: <term>Win rate</term>: matches won by players who bought the item, out of all matches where it was bought, with a 95% interval.
list.howBuyRate: <term>Buy rate</term>: share of player-matches in scope in which the item was bought (of the selected hero’s matches when a hero is chosen).
list.howBuyTime: <term>Avg. buy time</term>: average match clock at purchase.
list.howMinimum: Items bought in fewer than {count} matches in this scope aren’t listed. Corrupted purchases are excluded.
list.howLead: Players who are ahead buy more items sooner, so an item’s win rate partly reflects the lead, not only the item.
list.buyRateUnavailable: Buy rates are unavailable right now: the total number of matches in scope couldn’t be loaded.
list.noItemsDescription: No item was bought in {count}+ matches in this scope. Try a longer window or a wider rank band.

table.caption: Items by win rate, buy rate and purchase time
table.buyRateMissing: Total matches in scope couldn’t be loaded

filters.gameModeNote: Normal (6v6). Street Brawl is played in rounds, so purchase minutes don’t apply to it.

detail.performanceDescription: How often it’s bought and how those matches ended.
detail.timingDescription: When players buy it, and the win rate of players who bought it at each point in the match.
detail.heroesDescription: Heroes whose players buy it most often. Select one to see its numbers for that hero.
detail.notEnoughDescription: {item} was bought in fewer than {count} matches in this scope, so no numbers are shown. Try a longer window, a wider rank band or all heroes.
detail.noTimingsDescription: No purchase data for {item} in this scope.
detail.noHeroesDescription: No hero bought {item} in {count}+ matches in this scope.
detail.phaseNote: Phases are the data source’s fixed time phases. “Net-worth adjusted” re-weights each phase’s win rate to the net-worth mix of players in that phase; it is still observational. Fewer players reach the later phases (shorter matches end first).

performance.winRateWhy: Matches won by players who bought {item}, out of every match where it was bought. 95% interval {low}–{high}. Players who are ahead buy more items, so this partly reflects the lead, not only the item.
performance.buyRateUnavailable: Unavailable: the total number of matches in this scope couldn’t be loaded, so no rate is shown.
performance.buyRateWhy: Share of player-matches in this scope in which the item was bought (the selected hero’s matches when a hero is chosen).
performance.purchasesWhy: Player-matches in which the item was bought.

phases.adjustedTitle: Re-weighted to this phase’s net-worth distribution (source: item-flow-stats)
phases.fewer: Fewer than {count} purchases in this phase: not shown.
phases.noneDescription: A phase is named only when it has 200+ purchases, its 95% interval sits entirely above every other phase’s, it leads the next phase by at least 1 point, and it also leads by at least 1 point after the net-worth adjustment. No phase meets all of these in this scope, so none is named.

chart.typical: Half of all purchases happen between minute {from} and {to}.
chart.range: Across minutes with {min}+ purchases, the win rate ranges from {low} (bought in minute {lowMinute}) to {high} (minute {highMinute}).
chart.noRange: No single minute has {min}+ purchases, so win rates by minute aren’t drawn.
chart.legend: Line: win rate of players who bought the item in that minute, with its 95% interval (band); minutes with fewer than {min} purchases are left out. Dashed line: 50%. Bars: share of purchases per minute; shaded: the middle half of purchases.
chart.tableCaption: Purchases and win rate by purchase minute, the values behind the chart
chart.footnote: * Fewer than {min} purchases (Low sample): not drawn.
